title: Control replies distinguish a transient SQLite busy or locked store from other storage errors
outcome: Control replies distinguish a transient SQLite busy or locked store from other storage errors
acceptance: For session_bind, turn_evaluate, turn_begin and turn_checkpoint, SQLITE_BUSY or SQLITE_LOCKED, under the configured SQLite busy policy, during BEGIN IMMEDIATE with autocommit still true, or before COMMIT after a successful explicit rollback, returns control_store_busy documented as transient for this attempt and retry-safe with the exact retained operation/key/payload and still-valid binding; COMMIT/rollback failures and other storage failures retain storage_error. One real busy regression per operation proves no changes and exact retry; include replay-under-lock and phase controls.

completion.summary: Landed phase-safe control_store_busy for bind, evaluate, begin and checkpoint with exact-retry guidance, real contention regressions, generic commit/rollback failures and private diagnostics. Full gate and independent pair passed; acceptance 1/1 passed; installed clean build ready on all four live stores.
